post_operation: use GFP_KERNEL instead of GFP_ATOMIC when caller is not in atomic context
critical_variable: the gfp_t flag argument (mem_flags) passed to usb_submit_urb / kmalloc-family allocators
path_conditions: Callsite is inside em28xx_init_usb_xfer(), an EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL function invoked from process context (driver init / mode-switch helpers); no spinlock is held, no IRQ-disabled region, not in tasklet/timer/IRQ handler. Therefore GFP_ATOMIC is unnecessary and GFP_KERNEL (which may sleep) is the correct choice.
notes: em28xx_init_usb_xfer() is called from driver setup paths (em28xx_start_analog_streaming, em28xx_init_camera, etc.) which all run in process context. The static analyzer DCNS (Bai et al. 2018) found this. Fix: GFP_ATOMIC -> GFP_KERNEL in the usb_submit_urb() call inside the for-loop.
